_provenance: provisional: Phase4 SI terrain/hydrology/sediment model (game has only abstract h=0..2 and moisture)

hydrology.boundary: open: perimeter cells drain to outside at their fixed rim height
hydrology._note: pipe coefficient defined per day; per-substep c = pipe_coeff_per_day/substeps (<=0.25). Ws limited to field capacity; excess exfiltrates to surface.
hydrology._note2: provisional: storms fall in first storm_substeps of 12; snow below 0C with degree-day melt; frozen ground ksat x0.1; interflow k_if*slope fraction/day of donor soil water

river._note: candidates: Qema>=threshold (hysteresis) & not pond; anchors: candidates also concentrated vs lateral neighbours; valid river component: acyclic, longest path>=min_river_cells, anchor fraction>=anchor_frac_min, cells/length<=max_width_ratio (rejects sheet flow)

hills.desc: rolling hills + gentle slope to SE outlet

valley.desc: tilted V valley (no carved channel) draining to S outlet notch

depression.desc: closed bowl, rim higher than centre (pond basin)

initial_river.desc: tilted plain with a carved channel that holds an EXISTING river at day 0: finite initial water stock (initial_water_m (3.5 cm, below the 5 cm pond depth) on the 1-cell centreline network, saturated soil beneath; counted in initial storage, no ongoing source) and an initial flow history (Qema = 1.5*q_on, downstream = along the explicit 4-connected centreline path, exiting at the south rim) so the network is present on day 0. Channel cells are labelled preexisting; only incision outside them counts as natural/emergent.

rim.outlet: lowest perimeter cell(s) define spill/outflow points

soil_biogeochem._provenance: provisional Phase4 (not in game): abiotic processes so nutrients are not permanently locked; all conserved
soil_biogeochem.formulas: N exchange q = D * (N_j - N_i) * min(theta_i, theta_j) between 4-neighbours (Jacobi, donor-limited); G -> O at litter rate; O -> N at abiotic rate (R unaffected)
